description: The supplied image is not a scientific figure. It is a single, low-resolution web graphic: the "Check for updates" badge (a circular ring divided into blue and yellow segments enclosing a red bookmark/ribbon shape, with the words "Check for updates" set in grey sans-serif type below, on a light grey gradient background). There are no panels, no axes, no scale bar, no legend, no sample labels, no data points and no numerically printed values anywhere in the pixels. Consequently the image cannot be decomposed into sub-panels and cannot be linked to any material system, processing condition or measurement. The paper context (Fe-35Mn-(15, 17, 19)Al-5Cu at.% low-density steels with hardness spanning 253.4 HV to 965.6 HV) is cited here only to record that the badge image itself supplies none of that evidence. For a materials-science reader without pixels, this item should be treated as an interface/placeholder artifact that was captured in place of the intended figure. No extraction of experimental content is possible; the only reliable statement is about the badge's shape, colours and text.

The image contains no axes, no tick labels, no units, no scale bar, no legend, no colour-scale bar and no data points.
The image contains no readable sample, alloy, composition or processing-condition labels.
Because only a single graphic element is present, no sub-panel structure (a)/(b)/(c) can be identified and no inter-panel linkage can be established.

The paper context describes Fe-35Mn-(15, 17, 19)Al-5Cu (at.%) low-density steels with hardness from 253.4 HV to 965.6 HV, but this badge image shows none of those data; it cannot be treated as evidence for them.
